name: Aside
description: Compact side panel, notification banner, or callout box. Typically narrower than a full editorial panel — used for contextual information, alerts, or subscription prompts. Don't use for: full-width heroes (marquee), icon feature grids (icon-block).
visualSignals: Smaller than a hero, often inset or contained width, may have a close/dismiss button, icon or small image paired with short text and a link

cols.contains: h3 heading + p body + a link

domInput.notes: Col 0 is optional icon/image; Col 1 is the text content.
